headlines: Every hit in the hideout is a bar hit (a share of a man's health bar, not a fixed HP); since the damper (v29.17) each one lands at 50 % on your men, Sarge and the heroes, the rattlesnake's swallow included.

Quick Draw Croak's and his son's hits grow with the tier: × 1 · 1.1 · 1.1 · 1.2 (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA). On MEGA the MEGA hideout rules also make every hit from his side count 2 times and every bar on his side 6 times longer (the king's and his sons'; since v31.95 the posse's, the ladies' and the snake's bars are the soak's, each on a multiple of 6); both measured on the real machines.

Bar hits a hit (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA): the king's shot 4 · 4.4 · 4.4 · 7.2, his whole storm 9 · 9.9 · 9.9 · 21.6, the son's shot 1.7 · 1.87 · 1.87 · 4.08, a bandit 1 · 1 · 1 · 2, a sharpshooter — · 3 · 3 · 6, a lady 2 · 2 · 2 · 4, the snake's lunge — · 2 · 2 · 4; the ladies' fire 1 a beat and a stampede horse 2 on every tier, never doubled. Each lands at 50 % (the damper), then × the man's share.

Bars, one commander: Quick Draw Croak 2,252 · 3,003 · 4,504 · 5,532 (the designers' time-to-kill chart on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD; the player-damage-threshold pass's table on MEGA, 3 HP under it, the × 6 landing after the rounding); the son 315 · 420 · 631 · 1,164, the brood's four on MEGA 546 each; on MEGA a lady 108, the snake 882, a bandit 24, a sharpshooter 30: since v31.95 THE MINIONS SOAK sets those four (its row), the × 6 inside each row, so each lands on a multiple of 6.

Since v31.95 (THE MINIONS SOAK) the posse, the ladies and the rattlesnake soak rounds of your rifleman at your commander level: a bandit 4 · 6 · 7 · 9, a sharpshooter 6 · 8 · 9 · 12, a lady 20 · 20 · 20 · 40, the snake — · 120 · 150 · 330 rounds (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA); at the lab's levels (30 · 33 · 100 · 40) a lady is 50 · 52 · 62 · 108 HP and the snake — · 309 · 469 · 882; a party of two or more counts them at level 75 (115 on MEGA). Quick Draw Croak's and his son's storms land every volley × 3.

The lab's levels: 30 · 33 · 37 · 40. Ranks 30 to 39 carry the same bar and HP for the eleven men, so EASY, MEDIUM and HARD meet the same men (the Claymore Sarge and the six heroes gain a little HP between level 30 and 37); MEGA's level-40 stock adds the tank and leaves the grenadier home.

Since the damper a single bar hit KOs a stock man only with his whole storm on MEGA, the son's whole storm on MEGA: the king's shot needs 3 or 4 in a row on EASY to HARD and 2 or 3 on MEGA; on MEGA his whole storm needs 1 (the commando 1) and the Sarge irons 1 (the Saber 2, the Claymore 3), a sharpshooter round 2 or 3.

The rattlesnake's swallow is built to KO (it carries his bar left + 1, × 2 on MEGA), but the damper halves it too: on MEDIUM and HARD a fresh man stands it and 3 or 4 in a row KO a stock man; on MEGA it still empties a full bar, so a rifleman falls to one and anyone else stands on 15 % of his bar (THE FLOOR, since v31.00) and falls to the next (measured: a fresh level-33 flame on MEDIUM took 3.2 of his 6 bar hits and stood).

Since Raziya's boss notes (v31.00): his single shot × 2 · 2 · 2 · 1.5 (4 · 4.4 · 4.4 · 7.2 bar hits); THE FLOOR: no single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar (he stands on 15 % and the next hit fells him; measured on every tier), so the level a man first survives one hit is 0 for everyone but the rifleman (a whole storm, 8 hits, as before); THE CAP: one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men (his storm's volleys measured on that many); a trampled man stands stunned 0.6 · 0.8 · 1 · 1 s.

No instant KO in a boss fight since v29.70 (a former KO takes 31.5 HP, 40.5 on MEGA): the hideout has none, measured. The heavy class lifts the bazooka and the commando to 60 · 60 HP at level 30 (70 · 70 at 40); the flame keeps his own 77 · 99.

The lab's own HARD fight is Isaac's army since Nov 13: commander level 100, his men at their own ranks (rifleman 25, M. gunner 30, bazooka 20, mortar 22, medic 0, radio man 1); its bodies are born at level 100. The HARD columns keep a level-37 roster (the lab's default ladder) so the tiers compare.

changes.card: CARD-RZB · RAZIYA'S BOSS NOTES: THE HIDEOUT AND EVERY FIGHT
changes.what: Live since v31.00: His single shot × 2 · 2 · 2 · 1.5 (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA): 4 · 4.4 · 4.4 · 7.2 bar hits (was 2 · 2.2 · 2.2 · 4.8). THE FLOOR: no single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar; the hit that would leaves him on 15 % of it and the next fells him (measured on every tier: his shot on a rank-0 medic, landing EASY 2 of 2 · MEDIUM 2.2 of 2 · HARD 2.2 of 2 · MEGA 3.6 of 2 bar hits, left him on 15 %, the next shot felled him; a rifleman keeps no floor). So the level a man first survives one hit is 0 for everyone but the rifleman (a whole storm, 8 hits, as before), and on MEGA the swallow fells a fresh rifleman but leaves anyone else on the floor (2 swallows). THE CAP: one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men (measured: his storm on that many + 2 men in his cone landed on 3 of 5 · 4 of 6 · 4 of 6 · 5 of 7, every volley; the stampede and the ladies' fire are no blow). The frame he plants a storm his son's storm comes off its clock and every lady lobs a fire patch onto the same men (measured on every tier: 2 ladies, 2 patches at his plant); the snake rings the sand where he will rise and rattles 0.5 s longer, × 0.7 his time on top; a trampled man stands stunned 0.6 · 0.8 · 1 · 1 s (measured); the sharpshooter, the lady, the snake and the son pay × 1.7 · 2 · 3 · 2.5 in dog tags and the drip × 0.7 · 0.6 · 0.6 · 0.6.

changes.card: CARD-KHP · THE KINGS' +120 HP FROM RANK 30
changes.what: Live since v29.72: Your hero kings (King Yeti, King Rex, Quick Draw Croak and Emperor Bear) carry +120 HP from their own rank 30, flat (Wyatt, Nov 4), and their bar grows by the same 120: at level 30 your hero Quick Draw Croak has 302 HP and a bar of 272 (was 182 and 152). A hero takes every hit whole, so each king stands about 1.8 times the hits he did (the hero rows of WHO SURVIVES); Jane and Princess Croak are as they were.

changes.card: CARD-BDC2 · NO INSTANT KO · THE HEAVY CLASS
changes.what: Live since v29.70: In a boss fight a blow that KO'd a man outright takes a price instead: 0.9 × the M. gunner's HP at the fight's recommended level, here 31.5 HP on EASY to HARD (35 HP at rank 43 of level 75) and 40.5 on MEGA (45 at rank 66 of 115), landing whole. The hideout has no such blow (the swallow already went through the bar hits' door): measured, the price never ran in any staging, on any tier, on either engine. THE HEAVY CLASS: the bazooka, the commando and the flame carry the larger of their own HP and 2 × the M. gunner's at the same rank: the commando 60 HP at level 30 (was 55) and 70 at level 40 (was 69); the bazooka 60 HP at level 30 (was 47) and 70 at level 40 (was 60); the flame keeps his own HP (higher). Their bar is the same, so who survives moves only where the smaller share crosses a whole hit; the HP a hit costs them rises.

changes.card: CARD-SOK · THE MINIONS SOAK: THE POSSE, THE LADIES AND THE SNAKE BY ROUNDS OF YOUR RIFLEMAN; HIS STORM × 3
changes.what: Live since v31.95: The bandits, the sharpshooters, the ladies and the giant rattlesnake soak a set number of rounds of your rifleman at your commander level: a bandit 4 · 6 · 7 · 9, a sharpshooter 6 · 8 · 9 · 12, a lady 20 · 20 · 20 · 40, the snake — · 120 · 150 · 330 rounds (EASY · MEDIUM · HARD · MEGA; — = the shipped bar). A party of two or more counts the rounds at the fight's reference level (75 on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD, 115 on MEGA); on MEGA the MEGA hideout rules' × 6 sits inside each row, so the number lands on a multiple of 6. Quick Draw Croak's storm (and his son's) lands every volley × 3 at the door: 1.125 · 1.238 · 1.238 · 2.7 bar hits a volley (were 0.375 · 0.413 · 0.413 · 0.9), a whole storm 9 · 9.9 · 9.9 · 21.6 (were 3 · 3.3 · 3.3 · 7.2); his strong shot, the posse's and the ladies' rounds, the snake's lunge and the stampede as they were.
